mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To equip individuals with practical language skills and hospitality expertise that empower them to thrive in global environments and enhance career opportunities.
mission.label: Mission

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be a renowned institution recognized for excellence in Language Training, shaping globally competent professionals for the international industry.
vision.label: Vision

founder.quote: Language skills can open doors to new countries, cultures, careers, and a future once thought impossible.
founder.body1: IIFLHM was founded to connect Kenyan talent with international education and career pathways — especially toward Germany and the wider European opportunity landscape.
founder.body2: Under the leadership of Soila Lasoi, the institute combines rigorous language training with practical hospitality and career preparation so graduates can compete with confidence.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the International Institute of Foreign Languages and Hospitality Management (IIFLHM) collects, uses, and protects personal information when you use our website or contact us.
privacy.collectBody: We may collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, programme interest, and message content when you submit a form or contact us.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to respond to enquiries, process application requests, improve our services, and communicate about programmes and intakes. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.shareBody: We may share information with service providers who help us operate our website or forms (for example form delivery services), and when required by law.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access to or correction of your personal information by contacting us using the details on our Contact page.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy-related questions, contact us at the email or phone numbers listed on this website.

terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the IIFLHM website. By using this site, you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: Content on this website is provided for general information about our programmes and services. Programme details, fees, and availability may change; always confirm current information with our admissions team.
terms.ipBody: Text, branding, and media on this site are owned by IIFLHM or used with permission. You may not copy or redistribute content for commercial purposes without written consent.
terms.liabilityBody: We aim to keep information accurate, but we are not liable for decisions made solely based on website content. Admission outcomes and partner requirements depend on qualifications and third-party criteria.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms can be sent using the contact details on this website.
